card.name: Unit mg after a dose number
card.fires_on: The unit word mg, or the /kg part of mg/kg, right after a dose number in drug-interaction and dosing text. Also fires once on 'y' (and) in 'bebés y niños'.

modes.label: mg after a dose
modes.description: The word mg directly after a dose number when a study dose of a drug is described.
modes.example: When duloxetine 60<< mg>> was co-administered with fluvox

modes.label: /kg in weight-based doses
modes.description: The /kg part of mg/kg in weight-based dosing for children or adults.
modes.example: Isoniazid 10 to 20 mg<</kg>> PO or IM 5 mg/kg PO

modes.label: Spanish 'y' for children
modes.description: The Spanish word y joining infants and children in a heading.
modes.example: Personas que cuidan bebés<< y>> niños

card.plain: It marks the unit right after a dose number, such as the mg in 60 mg or the /kg in 4 mg/kg.
